purpose: Sample provider QA disposition across geographically separate PROVISIONAL GCOV temporal candidates.

check_details.check: Able to open input NISAR file?
Coordinate grid metadata cubes are valid?
Calibration information LUTs are valid?
check_details.notes: `crosstalk` LUTs skipped.

check_details.check: Passes all `identification` group checks?
% Cumulative NaN and Inf and fill and near-zero pixels under threshold?
check_details.notes: GCOV_L_A_HHHH backscatter: If a 'FAIL' then all histogram bin counts are zero. This likely indicates that the raster contained no valid data. Note: check performed on decimated raster not full raster.

check_details.check: % Cumulative NaN and Inf and fill and near-zero pixels under threshold?
check_details.notes: GCOV_L_A_HVHV backscatter: If a 'FAIL' then all histogram bin counts are zero. This likely indicates that the raster contained no valid data. Note: check performed on decimated raster not full raster.

check_details.check: % Cumulative NaN and Inf and fill and near-zero pixels under threshold?
check_details.notes: GCOV_L_B_HHHH backscatter: If a 'FAIL' then all histogram bin counts are zero. This likely indicates that the raster contained no valid data. Note: check performed on decimated raster not full raster.

check_details.check: % Cumulative NaN and Inf and fill and near-zero pixels under threshold?
check_details.notes: GCOV_L_B_HVHV backscatter: If a 'FAIL' then all histogram bin counts are zero. This likely indicates that the raster contained no valid data. Note: check performed on decimated raster not full raster.

check_details.check: QA completed with no exceptions?
